name: LOW FUEL1/2
description: Respective supply tank fuel quantity is below the threshold value. Voice message "FUEL ONE/TWO, LOW".

procedure.text: Irrespective of fuel quantity indications, the low fuel warning procedure shall be obeyed.

procedure.heading: If both FUEL LOW warning indications are on:
procedure.text:
2. LAND WITHIN 10 MINUTES
After 10 minutes, a flame-out of both engines must be expected. If no adequate landing site is found within 8 minutes, consider a power-on immediate landing.

procedure.heading: If one LOW FUEL warning indication is on:
procedure.text:
2. Expect single engine failure (after approx. 10 minutes)
3. Fuel quantity indication — Check
If positive fuel indication in the main tank:
4. Both FUEL XFER PUMP sw's (F+A) — Check ON
5. Both fuel pump XPMP cb's (F+A) — Check in

procedure.heading: If both warnings remain on after checking the transfer pumps:
If one warning remains on:
procedure.text:
6. Expect single engine failure (after approx. 10 minutes)
7. Air condition (if installed) — Switch OFF
8. Bleed air — Switch OFF (if OAT > 5°C)
Due to fuel sloshing the indication may flicker; the master list indication is automatically latched for 60 seconds.

references: FLM EC135 T3H Sect. 3.10.1 (Helionix Step 3.5, 3 MFD)
